metadata.name: MedOrbits Checklists Library
metadata.description: Printable planning checklists for education, admissions, applications, examinations, career development, general organization, and international study.
metadata.disclaimer: These checklists are general informational planning resources. Users must verify applicable requirements with the relevant official authority.

categories.title: Admissions
categories.description: Admission documents, eligibility, counselling, fee payments, and enrolment.

categories.title: Applications
categories.description: Application preparation, document review, submission, tracking, and follow-up.

categories.title: Career
categories.description: Career readiness, resumes, cover letters, job searches, interviews, and job offers.

categories.title: Education
categories.description: Course selection, college comparisons, budgeting, study planning, and university verification.

categories.title: Examinations
categories.description: Examination registration, documents, preparation, exam-day readiness, counselling, and results.

categories.title: General
categories.description: Personal document organization, deadlines, document reviews, payment safety, and task completion.

categories.title: Study Abroad
categories.description: Destination research, international applications, budgeting, accommodation, visa documents, and pre-departure planning.

requirements: The PDF must exist at its declared path.
The PDF must pass content and file-quality review.
Manifest and schema validation must pass.
Public download links must be tested after deployment.
Verification claims must be supported by documented evidence.
Only resources with published status and passing publication checks may receive active public download links.
Featured status must never override publication status.
The generated application catalogue must remain synchronized with this manifest.
